from itertools import product

# SpaceX was founded in 2002; the stated movie was released in 1990.
movie_year = 1990
spacex_founding_year = 2002

facts = {
    "bee_named_Lola",
    "bee_takes_over",
    "otter_has_saxophone",
}
if movie_year < spacex_founding_year:
    facts.add("otter_movie_before_spacex")

# Negative conclusions are explicit literals, not absence of evidence.
rules = [
    ("R1", {"bee_destroys_wall"}, "walrus_builds"),
    ("R2", {"bee_takes_over"}, "bee_destroys_wall"),
    ("R3", {"bee_liger_same_initial"}, "not_bee_destroys_wall"),
    ("R4", {"otter_movie_before_spacex"}, "otter_not_swears"),
    ("R5", {"otter_has_seat"}, "otter_not_swears"),
    ("R6", {"otter_not_swears"}, "not_walrus_builds"),
    ("R7", {"otter_has_fitting_notebook"}, "otter_swears"),
]
# No other animal has a supported wall-destruction premise, so R1's
# existential antecedent reduces here to the bee's destruction.
preferred = {
    ("R3", "R2"),
    ("R6", "R1"),
    ("R7", "R4"),
    ("R7", "R5"),
}
opposite = {
    "bee_destroys_wall": "not_bee_destroys_wall",
    "not_bee_destroys_wall": "bee_destroys_wall",
    "otter_swears": "otter_not_swears",
    "otter_not_swears": "otter_swears",
    "walrus_builds": "not_walrus_builds",
    "not_walrus_builds": "walrus_builds",
}

# Exhaustively find fixed points of applicable, preference-undefeated rules.
models = {}
for bits in product((False, True), repeat=len(rules)):
    candidate = facts | {
        head for selected, (_, _, head) in zip(bits, rules) if selected
    }
    applicable = [
        (name, premises, head)
        for name, premises, head in rules
        if premises <= candidate
    ]
    accepted = [
        (name, premises, head)
        for name, premises, head in applicable
        if not any(
            other_head == opposite.get(head)
            and (other_name, name) in preferred
            for other_name, _, other_head in applicable
        )
    ]
    consequences = facts | {head for _, _, head in accepted}
    if candidate == consequences:
        models[frozenset(candidate)] = (
            [name for name, _, _ in applicable],
            [name for name, _, _ in accepted],
        )

print("Movie predates SpaceX:", movie_year < spacex_founding_year)
print("Fixed points found:", len(models))

if len(models) != 1:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: no unique rule-system result")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    model, (applicable, accepted) = next(iter(models.items()))
    positive = "walrus_builds" in model
    negative = "not_walrus_builds" in model
    expected = (
        "proved" if positive and not negative
        else "disproved" if negative and not positive
        else "unknown"
    )
    submitted = "proven"
    normalized_submission = {"proven": "proved"}.get(submitted, submitted)

    print("Applicable rules:", ", ".join(applicable))
    print("Accepted rules:", ", ".join(accepted))
    print("Walrus builds:", positive)
    print("Walrus does not build:", negative)
    print("Expected answer:", expected)
    print("Submitted answer:", submitted)
    print("CHECK PASS" if normalized_submission == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
